name: sufi-shrines
title: Mapping the Shrines of Pakistan
description: A citable, schema-validated dataset of Sufi shrines and sacred sites across Pakistan, covering Muslim, Hindu, and Sikh traditions. Built from a Google Sheets source, normalized at build time, and versioned in git.

resources.name: shrines
resources.title: Shrines (JSON)
resources.description: Canonical versioned dataset. Top-level object has schema_version, generated (ISO timestamp), count, and rows array.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Primary English name of the shrine or sacred site.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: Human-readable location string (city, district, province).

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Faith tradition of the site.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Decimal latitude as a string; valid range 20–42 (Pakistan region).

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Decimal longitude as a string; valid range 55–82 (Pakistan region).

fields.name: Founded/Opened
fields.description: Year or century of founding, free-text.

fields.name: Sufi Saint
fields.description: Name of the saint buried at or associated with the shrine.

fields.name: Image 1
fields.description: Primary image URL (http/https or empty).

fields.name: Image 2
fields.description: Secondary image URL (http/https or empty).

fields.name: Events
fields.description: Annual events, urs celebrations, pilgrimage details.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Main prose description of the shrine.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable row identifier. Also the directory name under `public/photos/` for self-hosted images. Not the URL slug — that is derived from `Name`.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Faith tradition of the site, in the current vocabulary: Muslim Shrine, Hindu Temple, Sikh Gurdwara, Nanakpanthi / Udasi Darbar, Jain Temple, Secular / Memorial. Supersedes the legacy `Category` column, which is still read as a fallback.

fields.name: site_type
fields.description: The built form of the site, as a short term. Qualifying prose belongs in `site_type_note`.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the site is in use: Active, Occasional, Heritage, Ruin or Destroyed. Qualifying prose belongs in `status_note`.

fields.name: support_level
fields.description: How well the entry is evidenced.

fields.name: info_level
fields.description: How complete the entry is.

fields.name: principal_figure
fields.description: The figure the site is dedicated to or associated with. Supersedes the legacy `Sufi Saint` column. A row may name more than one figure.

fields.name: figure_type
fields.description: What kind of figure `principal_figure` is, in the vocabulary: Sufi saint, Deity, Sikh Guru, Sant, Historical person, Individual, Collective. A small number of rows carry a longer qualifying phrase instead, which the archive keeps rather than flattening.

fields.name: silsila
fields.description: The Sufi order or spiritual lineage of the site’s figure, as the archive’s source states it — including where the source answers with descent or personal affiliation rather than with an order.

fields.name: year_built
fields.description: Year the site was built, where the archive records one.

fields.name: year_built_precision
fields.description: How exact `year_built` is — typically exact, circa, century, range or unknown. A few rows carry a longer qualification instead.

fields.name: year_built_note
fields.description: Qualifying prose about `year_built`, including where the archive’s sources disagree or where the recorded year may refer to something other than construction.

fields.name: figure_born
fields.description: Birth year of the principal figure, where recorded.

fields.name: figure_died
fields.description: Death year of the principal figure, where recorded.

fields.name: event_year
fields.description: Year of a dated event associated with the site.

fields.name: event_note
fields.description: Qualifying prose about `event_year`.

fields.name: qa_note
fields.description: Free prose recording what is uncertain, contested or unverified about the entry.

fields.name: needs_review
fields.description: A short code naming an unresolved question about the row, such as `figure_unresolved` or `events_placeholder`.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-separated processing markers recorded by the data pipeline, such as `DATE_SPLIT` or `NEW_FROM_FIELD_SURVEY`. Editorial bookkeeping, not a claim about the site.
